error_reason: The Planner incorrectly identified the time for the shortest shadow based on an arbitrary 'afternoon thermal maximum' rather than the correct physical principle that shadow length is inversely proportional to solar elevation, which peaks at solar noon. This fundamental error in applying physics to the scenario led directly to selecting option C (4:05) instead of the correct option B (12:05). Had the verification step correctly referenced the relationship between time of day and solar angle, the correct answer would have been derived.

hypotheses.rationale: The Planner incorrectly deduced that the shortest shadow occurs in the afternoon (afternoon thermal maximum) rather than at solar noon. This fundamental misunderstanding of the physical principle (shadow length correlates inversely with solar elevation, which is maximal at solar noon) led directly to selecting option C instead of B. Had the planner verified the correct physics (shortest shadow at solar noon ≈ 12:00 PM local time), the correct answer B would have been selected.
